rawContent: Still on a high after my memoir about #mentalhealth, #MeToo, #motherhood and #journalism was shortlisted in this year’s @Mslexia award. If #writing it was a cathartic experience, having it shortlisted was immense validation. Now to figure next steps and aim for publication

#Writing an essay about my relationship with sex and how my history of assault and conditioning have shaped that. It’s a piece I’ve been considering for a while. Today I felt brave enough to begin. 840 words have poured onto the page and it’s cathartic stuff #metoo #mentalhealth
Today is going to be immeasurably hard for many survivors #metoo

And there’s a reason why I choose not to name the man who raped me, because I don’t want to give him the oxygen, because he was powerful and because this is my way of regaining my power and because sadly I know what other survivors have to deal with #metoo

This morning I read the experience of 20 of the 60 women who accused #BillCosby of sexual assault and I’m floored. As a survivor of sexual assault, I am triggered, raging and devastated powerful men still get away with abusing their positions, women get shamed and silenced #MeToo
